description: Source code for a web page clipping and screenshot tool within the Notesnook project, including functions for clipping pages/articles, capturing screenshots, and node selection UI.

methods.name: clipPage
methods.description: Generates a full HTML snapshot of the page, optionally only visible parts.

methods.name: clipArticle
methods.description: Extracts the main article content from a page using Readability and returns it as HTML.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes node selection UI and event listeners.

methods.name: clipScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the page in specified format (jpeg, png, svg).

methods.name: enterNodeSelectionMode
methods.description: Enables UI for selecting DOM nodes to clip.
